topics.name: DWH Data Migration and Backfill
topics.purpose: Define explicit transformation/backfill of existing records into a target schema version with exact source revisions, destination writes, lineage, classification and quality validation.

semantics.source_rule: Backfill reads exact source schema/version/record revisions.
semantics.target_rule: Writes target exact target schema/version/instance identities.
semantics.lineage_rule: Migrated values retain source record/revision and transformation provenance.
semantics.quality_rule: Target validation/quality rules run before migrated data is accepted.
semantics.batch_rule: Batching/chunking is execution strategy and does not alter migration semantics.
semantics.idempotency_rule: Re-running an accepted migration batch is idempotent or explicitly conflict-detected.
semantics.authority_rule: Backfill uses normal DWH write/transaction authorization.

invariants.rule: Schema evolution is an explicit versioned migration between exact schema identities/versions with validated compatibility and data transformation provenance; runtime/file order never silently changes active data meaning.
